# routeros_system_keymat_provider (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_system_keymat_provider" "hkdf" {
  name        = "hkdf-keymat"
  type        = "hkdf"
  hkdf_hash   = "sha256"
  hkdf_secret = "000102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f101112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the key material provider.

### Optional

- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `hkdf_hash` (String) Hash algorithm used by the HKDF provider.
- `hkdf_secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret used by the HKDF provider (hexadecimal value).
- `key_size` (Number) Requested key size in bits.
- `qkd_address` (String) KME device address (IP:port).
- `qkd_cache_size` (Number) Number of unused keys to keep in the cache.
- `qkd_certificate` (String) Certificate used to authenticate to the KME; also specifies the local SAE ID.
- `qkd_kme_id` (String) KME ID that must match the KME ID in the received TLS certificate.
- `qkd_peer_sae_id` (String) Peer (master or slave) SAE ID.
- `type` (String) Type of the key material provider: qkd or hkdf.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `qkd_cache_state` (Number) Current number of unused keys in the cache.
- `qkd_total_keys_received` (Number) Total number of keys received from the KME.
